source: closed-form from CDL spec (_spec/03,02,01; CDL §7.x); independent re-derivation
compare_regime: Real banded/bit-exact (rtoly~1e-9; exact f64 ops -> bit-exact)
input: constant k=2, T=1 wired as inputs; y_start=0.25; dt=0.5 grid; initial x = u - T*y_start/k = 0.875, then the implicit filter tracks the step down to u=0.5
reference_rule: Emit y=(k/T_nonZero)*(u-x) from prior x (first tick: x = u - T*y_start/k, raw T); then x advances by the implicit filter x'=(u-x)/T_nonZero; T_nonZero=max(T,100*eps); Buildings Reals/Derivative.mo (k, T are RealInputs)
format: Modelica CombiTimeTable CSV (_spec/07 §9); signal CSV is time+one output; reference.csv is time+inputs+all outputs; ryu shortest-round-trip f64
